summary: npm package used as CDN vehicle for browser redirector
details: px8my@1.0.31 ships a browser-side script as its main entry that creates a full-viewport iframe pointing at https://mfmz.xdjet.cn/H.html?c=0gjr via document.createElement/document.write. It is not usable as a Node library — require() would throw immediately on the reference to `document`. There are no install lifecycle hooks (preinstall/install/postinstall), no top-level Node side effects, no filesystem writes, no credential access, and no outbound network from a Node context. A shipped update_px8my.sh indicates the maintainer rotates the destination domain and republishes to npm and jsDelivr, i.e. the package is used as a CDN-hosted browser redirector rather than an npm dependency. Installing or requiring this package in a Node/build pipeline does not execute the redirector code and does not harm the installer. The concern (registry abuse; redirector pulled into third-party web pages via jsDelivr) affects visitors of pages that embed this script, not npm installers.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
